term_and_condition:
Welcome to Improvationality! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use a product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

  • Affiliate links are automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else's referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

  • Affiliates may or may not be assigned to a coupon code with details and usage clarified on the Dashboard. If a customer both clicks on the affiliate link and uses the coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

  • Affiliates may also advertise the merchant's website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and Payment

  • For every successful sale referred by an Affiliate, the Affiliate will receive a commission amount equal to 5% of the order value, exclusive of any extra fees (e.g., tax, shipping cost).

  • To receive commissions, Affiliates must specify their PayPal payment details in the Settings. The payment schedule will be provided in the Affiliate Guide page.

  • Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, which allows the merchant to review each and every referral order. Commission statuses will be displayed in the Commission tab, and any paid commissions will be listed in the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing Tools

We may share promotional media such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions with you through the Marketing Tools tab. You can download the media or obtain the HTML embed code to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, affiliates can invite others to become their downline affiliates. If any downline affiliate brings orders to the merchant's shop, the upline affiliate will also receive a network commission, which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share your network link, and any affiliate who clicks on that link and signs up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookie

We use cookies to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to enable cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies, then we can't track them, and earnings won't be paid on that person's activity.

The cookie duration is specified on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking period will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie duration, every order made by this customer on the merchant's website will automatically result in commissions for the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link again).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting admin@improvationality.com.

Go ahead and refer!

We're delighted you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always revisit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future, and if you have any questions, you can send an email to admin@improvationality.com for support.
